rationale: The response maintains the bass-fishing metaphor throughout, explaining complex legal concepts with consistent and increasingly strained analogies, without any plain-English definitions.
quote: Oral argument is the moment when the lawyers stand on the front deck of the Court’s bass boat and try to make one clean cast, while nine justices keep rocking the boat and asking, “What pound-test line are you using? What if the water level drops? What if this fish was caught in a private pond? What if the frog lure is actually a duck?”
